methodology.scope: Reference metadata only; no local motion geometry, frames or colors exist.
methodology.exact: Normalized source URL plus individual sourceCardId, preserving query/fragment/path.
limitations: All reference identities are audited; visual/behavioral similarity of remote works is unassessed.
Shared page URLs and similar titles do not establish duplicate assets.

familyGroups.reason: Different individually identified cards on one source page.
familyGroups.recommendation: Retain distinct card identities; a shared collection URL is not evidence of duplicate motion.
